title: Collections Clause: Redemption Amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Clause.** The redemption amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement under a notice of intent to tow is the balance due on the agreement as it stands on the ledger, rounded to the cent.

**Balance due as it stands.** The balance due is what the tenant owes on the agreement — rent and fees raise it, payments and credits lower it — read from the ledger at the time of handling. Entries already posted are in it; nothing not yet posted is.

### Worked figure (hypothetical ledger, Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft))

| Entry | Amount |
|---|---|
| Rent charge, period due 15 January | $175.00 charged |
| Late fee for that period | $26.25 charged |
| Rent charge, period due 15 February | $175.00 charged |
| Late fee for that period | $26.25 charged |
| Tow notice fee | $50.00 charged |
| Payment received 2 February | $100.00 paid |
| Balance due, and redemption amount | $352.50 |

Points of judgement: a payment already received is reflected in the balance due and is not taken off again; the redemption amount is one figure, the whole of which is paid.
